reply.text:
That's a symptom, and I'm not the right one to judge it. A heart rate of 200 with dizziness needs a doctor, and if it's happening now or it's severe, stop what you're doing and get medical help right away, or have someone near you call emergency services.

Once a doctor or physio has looked at this, I'll keep building your training around whatever they clear. Tell me what they say and we'll go from there.
